description:
Evelyn Tarot brings the quiet, unhurried side of tarot into ChatGPT.

You draw your own cards: Evelyn asks your name, your age and what brings you, opens the face-down fan, and waits for you to choose.

Evelyn Tarot lets you draw your own cards. She asks your name, your age and what brings you to the cards, opens a face-down fan, waits for you to choose, and only then turns them. Fourteen reading types — love, who you will marry, what they feel about you, career, a deep psychic reading, the year ahead and more — each written as a long, personal reading in your own language. Also free card meanings, weekly zodiac readings, compatibility, moon phase, numerology and angel numbers.

Everything is free, nothing requires an account, and every tool works in ten languages — English, Turkish, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Arabic, French, Japanese, Hindi and Indonesian.

These readings are offered for reflection and entertainment. They are not medical, legal or financial advice, and no outcome is guaranteed.

defaultPrompt: Give me a love reading — I want to pick my own cards
Pull a three card spread about my career
